title: US scalar weapons rumor
summary: Ross Coulthart tells of US scalar weapons rumor, about present at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they've told me second hand stuff suggesting that the US has developed what what are called scalar weapons.

plain: A journalist named Ross Coulthart says on Jesse Michels' podcast that people have passed him second-hand information suggesting the United States has built what are called scalar weapons, a kind of exotic energy weapon whose workings he does not spell out. If true, it would mean the US has secret weapons beyond anything publicly known.
